model_annotation: The image presents a nested donut chart comparing two sets of metrics: "Ambiguity Std" represented in the outer ring and "Max Ambiguity" in the inner ring. The inner ring consists of three sections in lighter shades of blue with black percentage labels placed inside the slices: a darker sky blue segment at 47.7%, a medium sky blue segment at 38.0%, and a pale blue segment at 14.2%. A second titled legend, "Max Ambiguity (Inner)", maps these inner slices to the categories "Max: 1", "Max: 2", and "Max: 3". The segments in both rings are not strictly ordered by descending or ascending size around the circle, and none of the slices are visually emphasized by being offset, exploded, or bordered.
